Subject: MPA: security & retention sync — proposed evidence schedule

Hi Daniel / Aurora legal team,

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Attached is the current MPA draft with our suggested sequencing for security gates and the minimal evidence set we typically need to close evaluation for hosted + dedicated deployments. High-level asks:

- Confirm who will own SIG/CAIQ completion vs. whether you'd prefer Redwood to pre-fill and have Legal redline.
- Confirm DPA redline deadline (we're proposing 2026-01-08).
- Confirm data residency needs (you mentioned EU backups; is that a hard requirement for backups and logs?).
- SOC 2: we can provide the attestation excerpt now; full evidence (control descriptions + sample logs) will take 2–3 weeks to bundle.

Proposed schedule (high level):
- 2025-12-15: Share MPA + evidence index (attached).
- 2025-12-22: SIG/CAIQ questionnaire / initial redlines due from Aurora legal.
- 2026-01-08: DPA signoff target (DocuSign).
- 2026-01-12: Evidence handoff for SOC 2 / technical artifacts.

Attachment: MPA_v1_Aurora_comments.pdf (redlined draft)
Attachment: SOC2-Attestation-Excerpt.pdf (public SOC 2 report excerpt)

Goal: keep the evaluation on a 4-week runway while preserving the data retention commitments you requested. If Aurora needs EU-only backups for certain data classes, flag them now so we can add an appendix to the DPA.

Thanks,

Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MPA: security & retention sync — proposed evidence schedule

Soojin — thanks, this is helpful.

Quick clarifications from our side:
1) EU backups: for regulated products we need EU residency for backups and for log retention beyond 90 days. For production snapshots shorter than 90 days we can accept US residency, but logs and backups for regulated customers must be EU-only.
2) SIG/CAIQ: Legal prefers we get a pre-filled version from you and then we redline. That speeds things up.
3) DPA: 2026-01-08 looks fine; I'll ask our procurement team to prioritize.

Looping in our legal contact (they'll handle the DPA redline):
From: Aurora Systems Legal <legal@aurorasys.com>

I'll upload our internal audit scoping doc if it helps.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director, Integrations | Aurora Systems
daniel@aurorasys.com

Subject: Re: MPA: security & retention sync — proposed evidence schedule

Thanks Daniel — noted on the EU backups requirement. A few specifics from our side so the MPA can be updated before the pre-fill: 

- SOC 2 attestation: we can share the current SOC 2 Type II report excerpt immediately (already attached in Soojin's mail). For the evidence bundle (control narratives + samples), target delivery is 2026-01-12 if we scope to the minimal set described in the attached audit-scope-appendix. If Aurora needs additional system-level logs beyond what we typically include, adjust the delivery by +1 week.

- Data residency carveout: we can offer EU backup residency for specific customer environments (we'll note this as an appendix to the DPA). Implementation path: snapshot export to an EU region object store (managed by Redwood) + restricted access keys. Operational lead: Marcus Lin (cc).

- SIG/CAIQ pre-fill: Soojin, we can pre-fill the questionnaire by EOD Tue 12/16 and share a pre-populated doc for legal redline. That should keep your 12/22 target realistic.

Marcus — can you confirm the estimated ops time to enable EU-only backups for a single tenant (rough ballpark)?

—Neha

Hi Soojin / Neha / Daniel,

Thanks for the plan and the quick turnaround on the SIG pre-fill. We reviewed the high-level schedule internally and can commit to the proposed dates with two small asks:

1) Please include a short appendix in the DPA that describes the EU backup process and the controls around key access (we'll need that for our audit).
2) For SOC 2 evidence, please mark any artifacts that contain customer-identifiable information — we'll request sanitized samples where needed.

Accepting timeline:
- 2025-12-22: We'll return redline to the pre-filled SIG/CAIQ.
- 2026-01-08: Target DPA signoff (DocuSign link preferred).
- 2026-01-12: Target evidence handoff for SOC 2 materials.
